text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during an outing with Kitasan
Black...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look! They have Cuties over there!
Aw, they
sure take me back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black points toward a claw
machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Dia's super awesome at claw
machines!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Before I entered Tracen, I'd always play
a round or two on the way back from
watching a race. I would try to get the
ones that look like Teio and
the others!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they've added more
varieties since then. I'm really bad at
these games, so I never
managed to win
anything. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black appears to be drawn to
the
plushies. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
